note: Phase 0 register (docs/briefs/2026-10-27-bulletproof-growth-engine.md, sections 0, 4 and 8). The review's list of 48 fixes was never committed, so this list is rebuilt from evidence: every commit body on main at d40b54c (56 commits), the descriptions of the 26 merged pull requests, docs/RELEASE.md, NOW.md, docs/history/2026-10-27-growth-session-handoff.md and the plan. A fix is a correction of earlier behaviour: a bug, a wrong word shape on a card, a protocol mismatch or a doc that said something untrue. The evidence gives 48. The ids the plan names keep their meaning (F03 replay, F06, F14 and F16 duplicates and priority, F08, F09, F10, F11 and F12 retired routes, F13 protocol drift, F15, F18, F20, F21, F22, F23 and F25 ranking by vanity, F27 to F45 card words with F30 and F45 unknown versus zero, F48). The other ids are this file's own, numbered in the order the fixing change landed, so they may not match the review's private numbering one for one. Judgement calls: F01 to F06 are the six corrections the 2.0.0 independent review records in docs/RELEASE.md, in its order; F07 is the earlier nested global-provenance regression the same record names; F17 is the first review fix in PR #9; F19 and F20 split the stale canon into the row words (fixed) and the pinned snapshot copy (still stale); the timeout raise in PR #10 is told inside F22, the doc that lagged it; the round-2 leftovers in PR #17 are folded into the PR #15 fixes they finish (F38, F40, F41). Not counted: the failed live runs of 19 October (attempt_unconfirmed, fixed on Control Center's side, not here) and the N findings closed by PRs #24 to #26, which are listed under findings. Every guard names a test in tests/ whose text holds the quoted name, checked by tests/register.test.mjs.

findings.what: A second Control Center wake on the same London day replayed the first report, though the protocol gives a later wake a new run_id. The per-day budget of pitch drafts stays Phase 2.
events[] is always empty, so closes are never reported.
The directive's north_star, urgency, constraints and rows_rule were read nowhere. PR #25 reads north_star, urgency and constraints; rows_rule is still unread.
Policy fields voice, recognition, acquisition, pilot, venture and execution.* are never read, and row, fit and pitch caps and the 70/30 split are hard-coded.
The 1.9.0 pitch outcomes were read nowhere. PR #25 counts bookings from them; learning which shows answer is still missing.
A repeated pitch_off No never reaches the weekly review as a doctrine change.
Mutation-kill claims in PRs #12 to #19 cannot be re-run: no harness is committed or run in CI.
Docs drift: NOW.md head lags, docs/history/LOG.md is named but missing, merged PRs are called unmerged, and the protocol header says 1.8.0 while documenting 1.9.0.
The trust-asset prompt's formats differ from contracts/motions.ts.
The founder_visibility_open hold was never recorded.
The registry target was a flat 5 against the ladder; good_meetings now reads the ladder from docs/NORTH_STAR.md.
The pinned canon review lapses on 15 November.
The held prospects were never turned into one decision.
strategicPlan().digest is computed and never read.
The engine never recomputed amended_sha256 before acting on an amended decision.
A campaign plan over 8,000 characters failed the whole report instead of holding.
blobSha hashes decoded text, so it gives the wrong SHA for a binary file such as a PDF.
Every approved stage plan decision was routed to prepare-action whatever its id; only gmc- campaign plans reach it now.
Plan version 2 said Vercel page views would measure the one-sheet, but Web Analytics is off for the project and a PDF runs no page tag; version 3 corrected it.
